title: Priorities and preferences.
bodyText: In selecting applicants for funding, the department shall make every effort to ensure that community-based economic development activities and community-based enterprises are distributed throughout the State.
bodyHtml: §210D-12  Priorities and preferences.  In selecting applicants for funding, the department shall make every effort to ensure that community-based economic development activities and community-based enterprises are distributed throughout the State. [L 1990, c 111, pt of §2; am L 1996, c 192, §12]
